messages.author: 20c6dbb46920d12c
messages.subject: changing the relative scale in "size"
parts:
Hi all,

Is there any way to change the way the size parameter works, so that the contrast, for example, between 1 and 5, is closer to being directly proportional?


d<-structure(list(x = structure(1:5, .Label = c("A", "B", "C", "D",
"E"), class = "factor"), y = 2:6, z = 1:5), .Names = c("x", "y",
"z"), class = "data.frame", row.names = c(NA, -5L))

ggplot(tst.data,aes(x,y,size=z))+geom_point()


Adam Loveland
